## History

God is not directly featured in the events, but Mrs. [Wace](../character/wace.md) reflects on His role in human life while comforting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) following the sudden death of [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md). During their conversation about grieving and moving forward, Mrs. [Wace](../character/wace.md) remarks that God requires people to keep living even after suffering a great loss.
